feature: Power Flow Visualization Code Quality Improvement
workflow_rationale: Systematic quality improvement requiring multi-file changes with consistent patterns. While refactoring existing code, the focus on adding consistency, documentation, and clarity represents feature-like enhancement work.

phases.name: Setup & Audit
phases.description: Inventory all algorithm implementations and document current patterns and inconsistencies

subtasks.description: Create algorithm inventory document listing all algorithm functions, their locations, and current naming patterns
subtasks.notes: Created comprehensive algorithm inventory document (docs/algorithm_inventory.md) documenting all algorithm functions across 12+ HTML files, including Newton-Raphson, Fast Decoupled, Gauss-Seidel, DC Power Flow implementations, naming patterns, and inconsistencies to be addressed.

subtasks.description: Create consistency checklist documenting all inconsistencies to fix
subtasks.notes: Created comprehensive consistency checklist (docs/consistency_checklist.md) documenting 37 specific inconsistencies across 7 categories: function naming, JSDoc documentation, sample data structure, architecture, code duplication, file organization, and documentation. Each item includes current state, target state, affected files, priority (P0-P3), and status tracking.

phases.name: Create Shared Modules
phases.description: Create reusable JavaScript modules for PowerFlowEngine and IEEE test case data to eliminate duplication

subtasks.description: Create shared IEEE test case data module (scripts/ieee_cases.js) with consistent SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE naming and JSDoc comments

verification.command: test -f scripts/ieee_cases.js && grep -q 'IEEE_14_BUS' scripts/ieee_cases.js && grep -q '@description' scripts/ieee_cases.js && echo 'OK'

subtasks.notes: Created scripts/ieee_cases.js with IEEE_2_BUS, IEEE_5_BUS, IEEE_9_BUS, IEEE_14_BUS, IEEE_30_BUS constants. All use SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE naming and MATPOWER v2 format. Includes comprehensive JSDoc documentation with @description tags, column format definitions, utility functions (getIEEECases, getIEEECaseByBusCount, validateIEEECase), and browser/ES6 module exports.

subtasks.description: Create shared PowerFlowEngine class module (scripts/power_flow_engine.js) with consistent method naming and JSDoc

verification.command: test -f scripts/power_flow_engine.js && grep -q 'class PowerFlowEngine' scripts/power_flow_engine.js && grep -q '@param' scripts/power_flow_engine.js && echo 'OK'

subtasks.notes: Created scripts/power_flow_engine.js with PowerFlowEngine class. Features: solveNewtonRaphson, solveFastDecoupled, solveGaussSeidel, solveDC methods with consistent naming. Comprehensive JSDoc documentation (33 @param, 73 @returns, 20 @description tags). Mathematical inline comments explaining Jacobian construction, power injection, Ybus building, LU decomposition. Browser/ES6 module exports.

subtasks.description: Create algorithm utility functions module (scripts/power_flow_utils.js) with matrix operations and convergence helpers
subtasks.notes: Created scripts/power_flow_utils.js with comprehensive utility functions: Complex number operations (create, add, multiply, divide, conjugate, abs, angle), Matrix operations (createZeroMatrix, copyMatrix, addMatrix, multiplyMatrix, transposeMatrix, scaleMatrix), Linear solvers (solveLinearSystem with Gaussian elimination and solveLU with LU decomposition, both with partial pivoting), Ybus construction (buildYbus, buildYbusFromMATpower), Power calculations (calcPowerInjection, calcAllPowerInjections, calcMismatch, calcBranchFlow), Convergence helpers (ConvergenceTracker class, checkConvergence, estimateRemainingIterations), Vector operations (vectorNorm, vectorAdd, vectorDot), Angle utilities (deg2rad, rad2deg, normalizeAngle). All functions have comprehensive JSDoc documentation with mathematical formulas. Browser and ES6 module exports.
